info.title: Lottery Stats public API
info.description: Public read-only SQLite-backed lottery data. No login, tokens, API keys or cookies required. Default quota: 60 requests per minute per client IP shared across these routes; configurable in Laravel. Successful and error API responses use no-store, nosniff and no-referrer headers. CORS permits only configured browser origins and no credentials; prefer same-origin requests. HEAD is supported by Laravel for GET routes. Preflight OPTIONS is handled by built-in CORS and does not consume quota. No public import/sync/admin endpoints. Error schemas describe production responses with APP_DEBUG=false; development server and throttling failures can include Laravel debug diagnostics.

get.description: Uses list ordering; 404 when the game has no drawings. Five has five main numbers (1–90); Six has six main numbers (1–45) and optional historical bonus kept separate; Scandinavian has separate seven-number machine/manual sets (1–35). Numbers are ascending, sets ordered main/bonus/machine/manual, prizes by tier. Prize amounts are exact decimal strings per drawing; historical dates, counts, amounts and currencies may be missing. Historical Six match_5_plus_1 applies only when a bonus exists. Other tiers: Five match_2..match_5; Six match_3..match_6; Scandinavian match_4..match_7. No query parameters are consumed.

get.description: Unknown query parameters return 422. Percentages round half-up to two decimal places and return 0 for an empty denominator. Statistics describe imported history, which may contain incomplete years or missing dates; they do not predict future results. Counts distinct drawings and actual eligible sets. Drawings lacking selected sets still contribute to drawing count and year/date coverage. Known date bounds exclude missing dates. Empty bounds are null.

get.description: Unknown query parameters return 422. Percentages round half-up to two decimal places and return 0 for an empty denominator. Statistics describe imported history, which may contain incomplete years or missing dates; they do not predict future results. Each count is the number of eligible sets containing the number. occurrence_percentage = count / eligible_set_count * 100, not a share of all balls. Combined Scandinavian may count a number twice in one drawing. Full game range includes zero counts. Ties use number ascending.

get.summary: Get odd/even occurrence shares and set distribution
get.description: Unknown query parameters return 422. Percentages round half-up to two decimal places and return 0 for an empty denominator. Statistics describe imported history, which may contain incomplete years or missing dates; they do not predict future results. even/odd occurrence_share_percentage = count / number_occurrence_count * 100. Distribution set_percentage = group eligible_set_count / total eligible_set_count * 100. Distribution sorts even_count then odd_count ascending; empty population gives zero shares and empty distribution.

get.summary: Get most frequent unordered number pairs
get.description: Unknown query parameters return 422. Percentages round half-up to two decimal places and return 0 for an empty denominator. Statistics describe imported history, which may contain incomplete years or missing dates; they do not predict future results. first_number < second_number. Count once per selected set containing both numbers; never pair across machine/manual sets. A k-number set contributes k*(k-1)/2 pairs. occurrence_percentage = count / eligible_set_count * 100. Only observed pairs, sorted count descending, first_number then second_number ascending. Empty population returns [].

get.summary: Get yearly counts and optional number occurrence
get.description: Unknown query parameters return 422. Percentages round half-up to two decimal places and return 0 for an empty denominator. Statistics describe imported history, which may contain incomplete years or missing dates; they do not predict future results. Source year ascending, including undated drawings; missing years are not fabricated. Without number, selected-number row fields are absent and meta.selected_number is null. With number, selected_number_occurrence_percentage = selected_number_count / that year eligible_set_count * 100. Empty population returns [].

Game.name: game
Game.description: Stable game code; a configured game missing from SQLite returns 404.

Drawing.name: drawing
Drawing.description: Numeric database drawing ID scoped to the selected game; IDs do not imply draw order.

Year.name: year
Year.description: Source year, including undated records. All population filters are intersected.

FromDate.name: from_date
FromDate.description: Inclusive YYYY-MM-DD lower bound; excludes undated records.

ToDate.name: to_date
ToDate.description: Inclusive YYYY-MM-DD upper bound; must be on or after from_date when both are supplied. Excludes undated records.

Set.name: set
Set.description: Five/Six: main only (default), excludes Six bonus. Scandinavian: machine (default), manual or combined. Combined counts each actual set separately; a drawing without the selected set contributes no denominator unit.

Sort.name: sort
Sort.description: number: ascending. most: count descending. least: count ascending including zeros. Count ties break by number ascending.

FrequencyLimit.name: limit
FrequencyLimit.description: Defaults to full game range for sort=number (90/45/35), otherwise 10. Cap; fewer rows can be returned.

Number.name: number
Number.description: Optional selected number: Five 1–90, Six 1–45, Scandinavian 1–35. Adds selected-number fields; does not narrow the population.

Page.name: page
Page.description: One-based page. Pages beyond the last return an empty data array.

NotFound.description: Unknown game, absent drawing, drawing belonging to another game, or unmatched route.

ValidationFailed.description: Invalid or unsupported query parameter. Error keys identify the rejected fields.
